mapper.select:
select A.*, B.category, (select concat(F.upload_path, '/s_', F.file_name, '_', F.file_dname, F.file_ext) from `Auct_FileUpload` F where F.anum = A.anum order by F.sort_no, F.fnum limit 1) as thumb
order by
A.anum desc A.start_amt, A.anum desc A.start_amt desc, A.anum desc A.join_cnt desc, A.anum desc
case when A.end_chk <> 'N' or now() > A.auct_end then 2 when now() < A.auct_start then 1 else 0 end, A.auct_end, A.anum desc
limit #{offset}, #{cntPerPage}

select count(*) from `Auct_Master` A left join `Auct_Category` B on A.cnum = B.cnum
where (A.prod_name like concat('%', #{value}, '%') or B.category like concat('%', #{value}, '%'))

select keyword, type, cnt from ( select A.prod_name as keyword, 'PRODUCT' as type, count(*) as cnt from `Auct_Master` A where A.prod_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') group by A.prod_name union all select B.category, 'CATEGORY', count(*) from `Auct_Category` B inner join `Auct_Master` A on A.cnum = B.cnum where B.category like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') group by B.category ) S order by (keyword like concat(#{keyword}, '%')) desc, cnt desc, char_length(keyword), keyword limit #{limit}
select A.*, B.category, W.name as win_name from `Auct_Master` A left join `Auct_Category` B on A.cnum = B.cnum left join `User_List` W on A.win_unum = W.unum where A.anum = #{anum}
select * from `Auct_Master` where anum = #{anum} for update
mapper.insert: insert into Auct_Master (unum, cnum, prod_title, prod_name, sales_addr, prod_type, as_type, start_amt, limit_type, limit_amt, join_amt, curr_amt, auct_start, auct_end, trans_type, contents, total_cnt) values (#{unum}, #{cnum}, #{prod_title}, #{prod_name}, #{sales_addr}, #{prod_type}, #{as_type}, #{start_amt}, #{limit_type}, #{limit_amt}, #{join_amt}, #{curr_amt}, #{auct_start}, #{auct_end}, #{trans_type}, #{contents}, #{total_cnt})
mapper.update: update Auct_Master set cnum = #{cnum}, prod_title = #{prod_title}, prod_name = #{prod_name}, sales_addr = #{sales_addr}, prod_type = #{prod_type}, as_type = #{as_type}, start_amt = #{start_amt}, limit_type = #{limit_type}, limit_amt = #{limit_amt}, join_amt = #{join_amt}, curr_amt = #{curr_amt}, auct_start = #{auct_start}, auct_end = #{auct_end}, trans_type = #{trans_type}, contents = #{contents}, total_cnt = #{total_cnt} where anum = #{anum} and unum = #{unum} and end_chk = 'N'
update Auct_Master set start_amt = #{bidAmt}, join_cnt = join_cnt + 1 where anum = #{anum} and start_amt = #{expectedAmt} and end_chk = 'N'

update Auct_Master set start_amt = limit_amt, join_cnt = join_cnt + 1, end_chk = 'B', win_unum = #{unum}, win_amt = limit_amt, end_date = now() where anum = #{anum} and end_chk = 'N' and limit_type = 'Y' and limit_amt > 0
mapper.select: select anum from Auct_Master where end_chk = 'N' and auct_end <= now() order by auct_end
mapper.update: update Auct_Master set end_chk = #{endChk}, win_unum = #{winUnum}, win_amt = #{winAmt}, end_date = now() where anum = #{anum} and end_chk = 'N'
